summary: Sturm, Ruger & Co. filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its October 14, 2025 Rights Agreement with Computershare Trust Company, N.A. as rights agent. The amendment accelerates the Final Expiration Date of the common share purchase rights from close of business October 13, 2026 to close of business September 16, 2026, terminating the Rights Agreement and causing all distributed rights to expire. No price, stake, premium, or recommendation is stated. This is a routine termination of a poison-pill plan, not a special situation involving a transaction or contest.
